question: A, B, C, D, E and F have different heights. E is taller than exactly 4 people and F is shorter than exactly 4 people. D is shorter than A but taller than C. C is not the shortest. How many people are shorter than C?
solution:
• A, B, C, D, E and F have different heights.
 
• E is taller than exactly 4 people and F is shorter than exactly 4 people.
 
• D is shorter than A but taller than C.
 
• C is not the shortest.
